title: Voice and gesture triggers during conversation
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on voice controls and hand gestures being activated during normal conversation, with one clearly negative complaint and two fragments that describe the situation without enough evaluative context.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says voice interaction is not helpful during calls or when talking with others in the car.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention gestures while talking triggering unintended changes or describe passenger hand gestures without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: The sample is very small, with only three fragments.
Two of the three fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall user sentiment.
One fragment is incomplete and only references passenger hand gestures without stating the outcome or evaluation.
